about:
Welk-Ko Fabricators Inc operates from Livonia, Michigan, where it was founded in 1967. The company remains a privately held fabrication shop, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The shop focuses on custom sheet metal fabrication, structural steel work, and portable mobile welding. In-house capabilities include shearing, CNC machining, forming, welding, and painting, allowing the team to produce NEMA-rated enclosures (Types 1, 12, 3R, 4, and 4X), push-button and multi-door enclosures, test stands, brackets, rack panels, chassis, cabinets, consoles, outdoor kiosks, machine guarding, and custom signage. The facility handles prototyping and short-run production alongside one-off projects.

Its customer base spans the electrical, automotive, and machine-tool industries, with enclosures and fabricated assemblies serving those sectors. The company also supports general industrial clients requiring custom metalwork.

Welk-Ko emphasizes rapid turnaround for prototypes and short runs, complemented by mobile welding services that can deploy to job sites. The firm cites a high repeat-customer rate and offers free estimates through an online quoting system.
